notes: Repo already carried a hand-built equivalent when the baseline was installed, so this is a merge rather than a fresh write. Deviations are listed below and are deliberate; a re-run should treat them as user-owned rather than drift to be corrected.

The marker table in the skill has no Dart/Flutter row. pubspec.yaml is the only marker here and detection would have produced no language-specific deny rules, so build/, .dart_tool/, *.g.dart and *.lock were derived by hand. *.g.dart is the heavy one in this repo: 15009 lines across four generated Isar files.

hook.why: Pre-existing hook with 21 self-test cases. It matches Read|Edit|Write|NotebookEdit|Bash, so unlike the baseline's Read|Grep|Glob|Bash it also stops writes into build/. It carries project knowledge a generic guard cannot: *.g.dart, an ask rather than a deny for raw documents (no fixture PDFs by decision, decisions.md 2026-08-11), and a deliberate non-block on .claude/tmp/check.log, which the project workflow requires the agent to read after a failed gate. Installing a second hook alongside it would mean two sources of truth for one rule.
hook.reRun: Update guard_paths.py instead of writing guard_context.py, or ask before replacing.

sizeThreshold.why: Calibrated against the largest legitimate file in this repo (pdf_import_screen.dart, 748 lines / 26 KB) and the largest doc (receipt-scan.md, 28 KB), leaving 2.3x headroom while still catching the generated files.

defaultMode.why: Declined by the user on 2026-09-07. The project already owns its planning layer: tickets are refined and ACs locked before implementation, with a hard stop after ticket creation. Plan mode would be a second gate in front of an existing one.

claudeMdBlock.why: Inserted with markers as specified, but two facts were corrected to match this repo: the hook path and the size threshold. Verbatim text would have pointed future sessions at a file that does not exist.
claudeMdBlock.alsoTrimmed: The hand-written 'Cheap lookups first' section was cut down to its project-specific half so the block and the project content do not restate each other.
